answer: Each identity posts a dual-book reconciliation bond: a juniper job log and a ferrous payment ledger must reconcile at close. Joining locks 90 credits, released only after an auditor recomputes both books and finds no gap. An auditor who finds a gap files a whisper report, freezing it and burning 30 credits. The kth fake needs its own 90-credit bond and pair of books, so 1,000 fakes lock 90,000 credits; cloning one book fails because the ferrous ledger is keyed to each identity's payment keys, and a rented book is rejected at recomputation. An honest agent pays 90 once.
